name: San Diego Open 2010
information: Entry will be in the Back doors. Competitor will be allowed to bring 1 person in with them. Please have lunch in between events or when you can, there is no scheduled break for lunch. This will be a long day due to the amount of Events and Competitors, please be ready when you are called and to make sure that All competitors may be asked to help judge or scramble please make sure you are familiar with the WCA regulations.
